reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited compensation paragraphs (§3(a)-(b)) contain only time-and-materials billing, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail and a rate-change notice — no most-favoured-nation, best-pricing or third-party-offer-matching obligation running against Company (Clear Capital).

No MFN burden on the Customer is exactly the rule's preferred position, so the correct outcome is a compliant finding with no redline and no comment; the rendered redline is identical to the original and the comment is empty, as expected.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped: the rate-change-on-30-days'-notice point is expressly reserved for the pricing/uplift rule rather than double-flagged here, and the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is correctly noted as welcome but not required.
No deterministic check failures; nothing actionable is missing for a compliant (evidence-only) finding.
